:::{#def-conditional-entropy}
#### Conditional entropy

For $X$ and $Y$ as in @def-joint-surprisal,
the **conditional entropy** of $Y$ given $X$
is the [expectation](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/expectation.html#def-expectation) of the [conditional surprisal](#def-conditional-surprisal) of $Y$ given $X$:

$$\entropyf{Y \mid X} \eqdef \E{\surprisalf{Y \mid X}}.$$

:::
